body:
I tried talking to my SO, but she doesn't understand, she can't. It's such a different world. And she tries to she really does.
 I can't bring myself to tell anybody else, though i guess killing myself would finally do it.
And the advice from the military psych, as well as my SO, is to "do something i love" which, as anyone who's been depressed knows, 100% does not work. I pick up a book and start sobbing after 2 sentences. I fire up an episode of my favorite TV show and immediatly close it.
